<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#14171C" flood-opacity=".16"/>
    </filter>
    <linearGradient id="heroFade" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#223344" stop-opacity=".18"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#14171C" stop-opacity=".82"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="posterBlue" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#445565"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#99AABB"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="posterGreen" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#00E054"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#223344"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="21" y="21" font-family="SF Pro Display, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="335" y1="16" x2="339" y2="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="16" x2="345" y2="10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="347" y1="16" x2="351" y2="8" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="361" cy="13" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <line x1="358" y1="13" x2="364" y2="13" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="371" y="8" width="17" height="10" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-opacity=".4" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="373" y="10" width="12" height="6" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="388" y="11" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000" opacity=".5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- cinematic hero image collage -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="32" width="390" height="372" fill="#14171C"/>
    <rect x="16" y="54" width="112" height="276" rx="10" fill="url(#posterBlue)"/>
    <rect x="139" y="42" width="112" height="300" rx="10" fill="url(#posterGreen)"/>
    <rect x="263" y="64" width="111" height="270" rx="10" fill="#445565"/>
    <polygon points="16,245 56,191 81,217 104,178 128,245" fill="#223344" opacity=".75"/>
    <circle cx="91" cy="112" r="18" fill="#C8D4E0" opacity=".8"/>
    <polygon points="139,238 174,173 204,208 228,162 251,238" fill="#14171C" opacity=".65"/>
    <circle cx="220" cy="100" r="24" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".72"/>
    <polygon points="263,248 296,193 322,218 348,168 374,248" fill="#14171C" opacity=".75"/>
    <circle cx="294" cy="111" r="15" fill="#F27405" opacity=".85"/>
    <rect x="0" y="32" width="390" height="372" fill="url(#heroFade)"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="76" x2="390" y2="76" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".14"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="360" x2="390" y2="360" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".18"/>
    <circle cx="23" cy="51" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".8"/>
    <circle cx="35" cy="51" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".8"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="51" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".8"/>
    <circle cx="343" cy="385" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".8"/>
    <circle cx="355" cy="385" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".8"/>
    <circle cx="367" cy="385" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- logo and hero copy -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="111" r="30" fill="#00E054"/>
    <path d="M181 111 C188 98 202 98 209 111 C202 124 188 124 181 111 Z" fill="#14171C"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="111" r="6" fill="#00E054"/>
    <text x="195" y="177" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">letterboxd</text>
    <text x="195" y="206" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Display, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Your films. Your friends. Your story.</text>
    <path d="M49 286 C108 254 151 252 195 276" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".32" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <path d="M195 276 C239 300 282 298 341 266" fill="none" stroke="#00E054" stroke-opacity=".65" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- action area -->
  <g>
    <text x="28" y="438" font-family="SF Pro Display, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Join the film conversation</text>
    <text x="28" y="461" font-family="SF Pro Display, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#667788">Keep a diary, rate what you watch, and discover your next favorite.</text>

    <rect x="25" y="483" width="340" height="54" rx="12" fill="#14171C" opacity=".12"/>
    <g filter="url(#shadow)">
      <rect x="23" y="480" width="340" height="54" rx="12" fill="#00E054"/>
      <text x="193" y="514" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Display, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Join Letterboxd</text>
    </g>

    <g>
      <rect x="23" y="550" width="340" height="54" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#969696" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      <text x="193" y="584" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Display, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Sign in</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- small feature cards -->
  <g>
    <rect x="23" y="624" width="163" height="72" rx="10" fill="#F4F6F8"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="650" r="13" fill="#00E054"/>
    <polyline points="42,650 47,655 56,645" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="70" y="650" font-family="SF Pro Display, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Track films</text>
    <text x="70" y="670" font-family="SF Pro Display, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#667788">Build your diary</text>
    <rect x="204" y="624" width="163" height="72" rx="10" fill="#F4F6F8"/>
    <polygon points="229,639 232,647 241,647 234,652 237,661 229,656 221,661 224,652 217,647 226,647" fill="#00E054"/>
    <text x="251" y="650" font-family="SF Pro Display, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Share reviews</text>
    <text x="251" y="670" font-family="SF Pro Display, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#667788">Find your people</text>
  </g>

  <!-- navigation bar -->
  <g>
    <line x1="0" y1="716" x2="390" y2="716" stroke="#969696" stroke-opacity=".35"/>
    <rect x="0" y="717" width="390" height="103" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="43,748 52,740 61,748 61,760 55,760 55,752 49,752 49,760 43,760" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <text x="52" y="781" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Outfit, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#667788">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="130" cy="748" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <line x1="136" y1="754" x2="143" y2="761" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="130" y="781" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Outfit, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#667788">Search</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="196" y="740" width="18" height="16" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <polygon points="201,756 204,761 208,756" fill="#000000"/>
      <text x="205" y="781" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Outfit, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#667788">Activity</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="292" cy="746" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <ellipse cx="292" cy="758" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <text x="292" y="781" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Outfit, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#667788">Profile</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <line x1="350" y1="740" x2="350" y2="758" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <line x1="341" y1="749" x2="359" y2="749" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="350" y="781" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Outfit, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#667788">More</text>
    </g>
    <rect x="128" y="808" width="134" height="5" rx="100" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- decorative eye detail -->
  <g>
    <path d="M173 111 C183 101 207 101 217 111" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".5" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M173 111 C183 121 207 121 217 111" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".5" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
</svg>
